name: a spell of snow
source:
Play as Sage, an otherwise bored girl visited each winter by a snow rabbit and a sack full of secrets. From an umbrella that brings rain, to a mug with a dark secret — even ordinary objects have power over their owners. Find out just how much, as you explore their stories in a shower of snowdust!

[From [url=https://pke1029.itch.io/a-spell-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演賽奇，一個平日覺得生活無聊的女孩。每年冬天，一隻雪兔都會帶著滿滿一袋秘密來看她。從能喚來雨水的傘，到藏著黑暗秘密的杯子，即使最尋常的物品也能左右它們的主人。趁著雪粉紛飛，探索那些物品的故事，看看它們的力量究竟有多大！

〔摘自[url=https://pke1029.itch.io/a-spell-of-snow]itch.io[/url]〕
